Package aor.proj3t.util

Class EmailUtil

java.lang.Object
aor.proj3t.util.EmailUtil
@ApplicationScoped public class EmailUtil extends Object
Utility class for sending emails and validating email formats.

Provides reusable methods for formatting and delivering email messages, including support for external SMTP configuration via environment variables or server-based injection using JNDI (e.g., Wildfly). Supports HTML content, validation with regex, and fallback strategies for dynamic session creation.

Features: - Environment-aware SMTP setup (.env or server context) - Supports HTML emails - Validates recipient format using regex - Uses injected JavaMail session if available - Gracefully logs and handles failures Limitations: - SMTP credentials are loaded at startup via Dotenv - Only sends emails via authenticated SMTP Example usage: 

     boolean success = emailUtil.sendEmail("user@example.com", "Welcome", "<h1>Hello!</h1>");
Configuration keys expected in .env or environment: SMTP_HOST, SMTP_PORT, SMTP_USERNAME, SMTP_PASSWORD
